question: How is the TOGAF ADM in Practice series organised?

scene.title: How TOGAF ADM in Practice is organised

narration.text: TOGAF ADM in Practice sits in the Architecture section. It has two parts and takes about 24 minutes to read in total.
Part 1, about 10 minutes, covers the Preliminary phase and the Architecture Vision, including the trade-offs and ways things go wrong that the standard leaves out.
Part 2 is the longer one at 14 minutes. It works through Phases B, C and D, turning business requirements into technology constraints.
Its main goal is to bring integration complexity to the surface early, before it turns into cost.
